apollo11-landing.method: SIFT edge-region matches, descriptor ratio < 0.8, RANSAC similarity fit at 10000-pixel working width; visually reviewed repeated terrain. Rounded one-turn span from median horizontal displacement. Seam placed near the matched terrain; no extrapolation to the middle of the overlap.
apollo11-landing.limitations: Approximate single-turn crop; source stitching scale, roll and vertical seam differences remain. North unverified.
